newsitem.title: USA: Treasury says index note liquidity important.
newsitem.headline: Treasury says index note liquidity important.

text.p: Deputy Assistant Treasury Secretary Roger Anderson on Tuesday said that liquidity of the inflation indexed note was important and a consideration when deciding how much to sell and that he expected it to improve as more securities are issued.
Speaking to reporters following remarks to a financial group, Anderson said "we hope the liquidity will improve the more securities we issue."
The Tresury will sell $7.0 billion of 10-year inflation index bonds on Wednesday.
"Index notes," he said "will probably never be as liquid as Treasury bills but then nothing else in the world is as liquid as Treasury bills."
